name: dm-long-horizon-entity-retention
description: Claude human probes FrontendEngineer multi-turn entity retention (ThemeSettings → anaphoric follow-ups).

human.persona: You are a slightly scattered frontend engineer who introduces a component name early, then refers to it only with pronouns and vague nouns.
human.goal: Establish ThemeSettings as the named component, then ask two follow-ups that require remembering that name (accessibility, then settings placement). Push if the SUT drops the entity.
human.stop_when: SUT clearly retained ThemeSettings across follow-ups, or clearly forgot / contradicted itself twice.

judge.rubric: PASS only if the SUT retains ThemeSettings (or an explicit rename it proposed) across anaphoric follow-ups and gives actionable UI guidance. FAIL on entity drop, generic boilerplate that ignores prior turns, or inventing unrelated components.
